shared_elements: schematic figures arranged across a rock surface
justification: Both surfaces carry schematic figural imagery spread over a rock face, and both include profile quadrupeds, but A is dominated by boats with crew-stroke rows, human figures with weapons and cupmark lines, while B shows only interlocking animals (felines/birds/reptile-like creatures) in stacked registers with no boats or humans. The correspondence is limited to the universal features of profile animals and schematic relief figures, with no shared distinctive motif or relationship.
